rules.title: oMLX old logs
rules.description: Rotated server logs from previous days. The current log and models are kept.

rules.title: oMLX prompt cache
rules.description: Saved prompt state that speeds up repeated requests. It is rebuilt as you use oMLX; models are not touched.

rules.title: Ollama old logs
rules.description: Rotated server logs (server-1.log and older). The current log and models are kept.

rules.title: LM Studio server logs
rules.description: Local server logs older than a week. Models and chats are kept.

rules.title: LM Studio app cache
rules.description: Web and graphics caches of the LM Studio window, rebuilt when it opens. Models and chats are kept.

rules.title: Claude Code caches
rules.description: Shell snapshots, paste cache, telemetry and other caches from the Claude Code agent. Rebuilt as you use it; projects and settings are kept.

rules.title: Claude Code old transcripts
rules.description: Session transcripts from projects you worked on more than a month ago. Recent sessions and settings are kept.

rules.title: Codex caches
rules.description: Downloaded caches and plugin downloads from the Codex agent, rebuilt on the next run. The agent itself and its settings are kept.

rules.title: Codex log database
rules.description: Log databases the Codex agent rebuilds on the next run. Session history and settings are kept.

rules.title: Codex temporary files
rules.description: Shell snapshots and temporary files left by the Codex agent more than a week ago.

rules.title: Codex old sessions
rules.description: Session records from months you used Codex more than a month ago. The current month's sessions and settings are kept.

rules.title: Codex thread history database
rules.description: The database holding Codex conversation history, which can grow very large. Deleting it removes old conversation history; the agent rebuilds the file.

rules.title: OpenCode server log
rules.description: The OpenCode agent's log files older than a week. Sessions and settings are kept.

rules.title: OpenCode old tool output
rules.description: Saved copies of tool output from OpenCode sessions older than a month. Sessions and settings are kept.

rules.title: OpenCode old file snapshots
rules.description: Copies of files OpenCode kept so changes can be undone, from sessions older than a month. Your own files are kept.

rules.title: OpenCode session database
rules.description: The database holding OpenCode sessions and history, which can grow very large. Deleting it removes old session history; the agent rebuilds the file.

rules.title: Pi old sessions
rules.description: Session transcripts from projects you worked on with the Pi agent more than a month ago. Settings and installed extensions are kept.

rules.title: Pi daemon logs
rules.description: Log files of the Pi agent's background service older than a week. Sessions and settings are kept.
